label: Gemini flash · G-P5-EVENT (G-P5, Gemini called only when something happened: level touch ≤0.25 ATR, RVOL ≥2, ATR ratio ≥1.3)
rules: Event-driven: Gemini called at the M15 close only for symbols whose closed bar came within 0.25 ATR of Session High/Low, VAH/VAL or a GEX wall, or printed RVOL >= 2, or ATR ratio vs 50 bars >= 1.50 (request shared with G-P5 when identical). P5 prompt + 5 P5 context fields, gemini-3.8-flash thinking low, at the M15 close +20 s on the shared snapshot. BUY/SELL with confidence >= 0.72 that pass the P5 gates (not stretched >= 2.4 ATR from EMA20 / 3.5 ATR from VWAP / 3-bar move >= 2.2 ATR; >= 0.85 ATR room to the opposing wall unless ATR ratio >= 1.3 and RVOL >= 2; no chase of a >= 1.8 ATR signal candle without a 25% pullback). XAUUSD, EURUSD, US100, XAGUSD (no GBPUSD / BTC). Stop 0.8 ATR / target 1 ATR / 90 min cap, 30-min dead-trade cut (MFE < 0.25 ATR and P&L <= -0.25 ATR). ~$900 risk full-size, max 6 open, one per symbol, 0.3 ATR fill check, daily loss stop $1800.
